interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about sustainable living.
questions: Q1: Can you share your personal experience with eco-friendly habits?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to live sustainably?
Q3: In your opinion, why is sustainable living important?
Q4: What advice would you give someone who wants to adopt a greener lifestyle?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite travel experience, and why?
Q2: What difficulties do you encounter when planning a trip?
Q3: How do you think travel affects personal growth?
Q4: What tips would you offer for planning an enjoyable vacation?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in maintaining a fitness routine?
Q3: Why do you think regular exercise is beneficial for health?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone starting to exercise?
